how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application period runs from 9 October 2026 to 23 October 2026, while the printed application along with original documents must reach the CDPO Bijepur office by 4 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Printed Application with Documents

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy advertised for the Anganwadi Worker post under Bijepur Panchayat Samiti. The single vacancy is located at Lemather-1 Anganwadi Centre under Hrudapali Gram Panchayat.

rows.catchment_area_range: From house of Sashi Sahu to house of Raghunath Rana

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be female and a permanent resident of the concerned Anganwadi area. If no eligible candidate is available within the Anganwadi centre area, candidates from the same revenue village, same revenue gram panchayat, or adjoining gram panchayat of the Panchayat Samiti may be considered. Educational qualification requires passing the 10th class examination or equivalent from a recognized board. Candidates must fall within the age limit of 18 to 35 years as on 1 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is carried out based on the merit of marks secured in the 10th class examination. Additional weightage and preference are given to candidates belonging to SC, ST, physically challenged (40% or above), widows, abandoned wives, orphans, and candidates who have successfully completed certificate or diploma courses in relevant fields associated with child development or allied activities as per government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in . Fill out the online application form for the Anganwadi Worker post between 9 October 2026 and 23 October 2026. Download and print a copy of the completed online application form. Gather all required original certificates including birth proof, educational qualification certificates, mark sheets, residential certificate, and category/caste/status proof (such as for widows, divorced women, or persons with disabilities). Submit the printed copy of the online application along with all original documents in person or by registered post to the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO), Bijepur office by 4 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Birth proof certificate Educational qualification certificates Educational qualification mark sheets Residential certificate Caste, widow, divorced woman, deserted wife, or orphan status certificate where applicable

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy for the Anganwadi Worker post has been announced under advertisement number 1048.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the deadline for submitting printed applications offline?
faq.answer: The printed copy of the online application along with original certificates must reach the CDPO Bijepur office by 4 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination or equivalent from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection criteria for this post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit calculated from the marks secured in the 10th class examination, along with additional weightage for specific categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Is this post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The official notification specifies temporary engagement for the Anganwadi Worker position.

faq.question: Q9. Who is eligible to apply based on residence?
faq.answer: Applicants must be a permanent resident of the concerned Anganwadi area, failing which candidates from the same revenue village, same revenue gram panchayat, or adjoining gram panchayat may be considered.
